summary: Verified both new features end-to-end: (1) AlienVault OTX sync — GET /api/otx/status returns configured+populated last_sync; POST /api/otx/sync requires JWT (401 without), completes in ~2-3s, returns proper summary, populates iocs with source containing 'AlienVault OTX' and non-'low' severity mix; second run is idempotent (updated>=added). (2) IOC bulk-save-flagged — /api/iocs/bulk accepts new payload shape {values,severity,source,tags} and persists. Frontend admin flow: OTX bar+button visible on /threat-intelligence with correct data-testids, click updates last-sync timestamp (8:04:10 -> 8:04:32). Bulk paste tab: pasted 44d88612fea8a8f36de82e1278abb02f + 8.8.8.8, Analyze all -> ioc-bulk-save-flagged shows 'Save all flagged (1)', click -> ioc-bulk-save-msg = 'Saved 0 new · 1 updated · 0 skipped' (already synced by earlier backend test run, hence updated). All 6 pytest tests PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: OTX sync loop schedules on every startup + every 24h — good, but no jitter; multiple restarts in short window could hammer OTX API. Acceptable for MVP.

_sync_otx_pulses returns dict on any HTTP error (e.g., 500 from OTX) but the endpoint still returns 200 with 'error' key inside the body. Consider raising HTTPException(502) so /api/otx/sync clients can detect failures via status code.
server.py is now >1600 lines — consider splitting the OTX module into backend/otx.py to keep files focused.
seed_data_creation: Bulk test inserted 44d88612fea8a8f36de82e1278abb02f and 1.1.1.1 with source='TEST_bulk_save_flagged'. OTX sync populated ~444 IOCs total.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTX auto-syncs on backend startup + daily. Manual sync via POST /api/otx/sync (JWT required) runs in ~2-3s. /api/iocs returns {total,items,limit,skip} — not a raw list. On subsequent syncs after startup, added=0 and updated~=indicator count is expected (idempotent). Frontend save-flagged msg reflects backend counters accurately.
